title: Milk-Only Purchases Counted in a Departed-Balance Cover (School Nutrition Services Meal Account)
content:
A departed-balance cover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts milk bought on its own by how many times it was rung up on the account in the month before the cover date: four (4) or more purchases make a regular buyer, and the milk-only price is added to every serving day counted; one to three purchases add once what the student spent on it in that month; no purchase adds nothing.

A date falls within the N months before the cover date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the cover date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

| Times milk bought on its own was rung up in the month before the cover date | What is added |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | the milk-only price (0.75) for every serving day counted |
| 1, 2 or 3 | what the student spent on it in that month, once |
| 0 | nothing |

### Input, judgement, result (hypothetical)

Input: milk bought on its own rung up on six days of the month before the cover date. Judgement: six is four or more, a regular buyer. Result: 0.75 for every serving day counted.

Input: rung up twice, for a total spent of 1.50. Judgement: one to three purchases. Result: 1.50, added once.
